body.name: Size
body.type: The encoding vector \(s=(n,m,c,K,R,o,\ell,J)\in\mathbb N^8\). Here \(n=|V|+|U|\), \(m=|E(G)|\), \(c=|\mathcal C|\), \(K=\prod_{i\in W}|\mathcal X_i|\), \(R=\sum_{i\in V}|\mathcal R_i|\), \(o=\prod_{i\in V}|\mathcal X_i|\), and \(\ell\) is the largest input rational bit length. The integer \(J\geq1\) is one plus the total number of state labels, primitive conditional-table coordinates, complete parent-assignment records, latent joint assignments, and row-equality incidences produced by expanding the finite state spaces and \(\mathcal C\).
body.role: The encoding vector, including the explicit expansion load needed to compile the quotient and finite contractions.
